title: opposite-category
description: The category C^op with the same objects as C and every morphism reversed; composition order is swapped. The carrier of duality: any categorical statement transfers to C^op with all arrows reversed. A category refined by the arrow-reversal involution.

reverses.description: same objects; every morphism f : A → B becomes f^op : B → A; (g ∘ f)^op = f^op ∘ g^op; (C^op)^op = C
